description: Course item D. The whole-map client projection was an explicitly named at-current-scale divergence; the sharpened arc goal (no large payloads - materializers can number in the thousands) re-opens it. FDB shape (GetKeyServerLocations, CommitProxyInterface.h:442-477, NativeAPI.actor.cpp:1246-1453): request {begin, end, limit(, reverse)}; reply bounded list of {start_key, end_key, tag, materializer_ref} with more?; proxy answers via :gb_trees iterator walk from ceiling(begin) joining materializers[tag] - O(limit log n), no to_list. Client: Link cache becomes a coalescing PARTIAL range tree merged on each fetch; LayoutIndex becomes a range-keyed partial cache whose miss path returns :not_cached (not raise) and triggers routing_fn.(key) -> bounded fetch centered on the key. StorageRacing and above unchanged. Named divergence kept: coarse whole-cache invalidation (vs FDB per-range) - simpler, failures rare; revisit if thrash appears. Reconcile with q67.21 mid-epoch mutation of materializers/ (proxy view stays current via the window pipeline; stale client entries resolve through the existing invalidate+retry).
title: Bounded routing lookups: fetch_routing takes {begin, end, limit}; coalescing partial cache
